notes: Knight kick (mw-e04.18): 10/3/16 ticks, 8 stamina, 3 blunt, 20 poise. World impact: a 140 N·s shove along the facing that moves things up to 40 kg (5.6 m/s for a 25 kg crate, about 3 m on wood; a 50 kg one resists, ImpactResisted). Small creatures (size class small) it hits are knocked back by the hit's 160 N·s impulse (4 m/s for a 40 kg goblin, plus the reaction's launch); larger ones just flinch. An unlocked closed door it reaches is slammed open, a locked one resists (src/sim/combat/melee/kick.ts). The 140 and 160 N·s, 600 N impactForce and staminaDamage 10 are placeholders until the combat sandbox tunes them.
